definitions: Hit or knock (something) with a bump.
Move or travel with a lot of jolts and bumps.
Postpone or cancel (an event or appointment).
Remove (someone) from a position or place, typically to make way for someone else.
examples: He bumped his head on the low ceiling.
The car bumped along the track.
The meeting was bumped to next week.
She was bumped from the team.
